_comment: RESERVED - NOT deployed. Robinhood is intentionally excluded from the USDC mesh (config/vault_mesh.usdc.json) because there is NO Circle USDC on Robinhood mainnet, and a wtnUSDC vault must never be backed by a different underlying. USDG on Robinhood is served by the usdg mesh (config/vault_deploy.usdg.robinhood.json). The canonical USDC address stays reserved here via the guarded salt. To add USDC once Circle launches it on Robinhood: set `usd` to the real Circle USDC address (verify 6 decimals on-chain), set thirdParty/worker to the production multisig, append `robinhood` to config/vault_mesh.usdc.json chains/active, then follow ADD_A_CHAIN.md section 3. `usd` is left zero so an accidental deploy reverts.
